conf.comment: HSPD-12 CMS operator/administrative audit (role grants, scope, profile/policy config, exports) - the CMS administering itself, not credentials. Same honesty warning as the lifecycle dataset: every field name is a FIPS 201-3/SP 800-79-2 placeholder, not a confirmed export column. Split from the lifecycle dataset into its own data stream even though it likely shares one underlying audit store.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose and placeholder-field honesty warning
Extract one polled administrative-audit record (assumed JSON body) into top-level fields

Computed fields read from ORIGINAL vendor names before rename: admin_action normalized onto a safe generic token (raw kept alongside), event.outcome left undefined rather than defaulting to success (a denied action is the signal worth having), config_new_value length-capped (credential-profile changes can carry large policy documents), export_record_count cast numeric, observer.name populated alongside host.name since a GSA shared-service cms_server may be a service name rather than agency-owned infrastructure, message length-capped

Batch rename of the direct 1:1 fields; the actor is user.name (operator_id) and the operator being acted upon is user.target.name (target_operator) - never the reverse, per recommendations.direct.cribl
Event time from the CMS's own record of the administrative action. Never targets @timestamp (platform constraint)
event.dataset (no hyphen) and cleanup of consumed originals
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
